question: A bike is purchased for ₹50,000. Its rate depreciates at 10% annually. In how many years will its value be ₹36,450?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A bike is purchased for ₹50,000

Its rate depreciates at 10% annually

**FORMULA USED: ** 

 Interest= Ptimes (1+(R)/(100))^T

Where P= The amount lent

R= Interest at the amount lent

T= Year amount lent for

**CALCULATIONS:**

⇒ The rate of interest depreciates annually is 

⇒ The value of the bike after T years= its space value space Tspace yearsspace ago ×(1− (R)/(100))^ T

⇒ 36450=50000times(1+((-10))/(100))^T

⇒ 729=1000times(1-(1)/(10))^T

⇒ (729)/(1000)=((9)/(10))^T

⇒ ((9)/(10))³ = ((9)/(10))^T

⇒ On comparing both sides, we get

⇒ T = 3yrs 

⇒ The value of the bike will be ₹36,450 after 3 years
